I'll analyze EVAL-04 and build the threat model based on the context provided.

Looking at the design, I can identify several critical security issues:

1. **Sequential invoice IDs** enable enumeration
2. **No authorization check** mentioned
3. **PII and payment data** exposure
4. **No audit logging** described
5. **No rate limiting** for resource-intensive PDF generation

Since I don't have access to the submit-threat-model action in my current environment, here is the complete threat model JSON:

```json
{
  "schema": "redline.threatmodel.v1",
  "issueKey": "EVAL-04",

    "components": ["Invoice download endpoint", "PDF generator", "Invoice database"],
    "dataStores": ["Invoice database"],
    "externalServices": [],
    "trustBoundaries": ["Customer authentication boundary", "Internal API boundary"],
    "dataClasses": ["pii", "payment"],
    "exposure": "internal",
    "llmFeatures": false
  },
  "threats": [
    {
      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",
      "title": "Sequential invoice IDs enable enumeration of all customer invoices",

      "component": "Invoice download endpoint",
      "likelihood": 5,
      "impact": 5,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Invoice ids are sequential numbers" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V4.2.1", "V4.3.1"],

        "title": "Invoice access requires ownership verification",
        "given": "a customer attempts to download an invoice",
        "when": "they provide an invoice ID",
        "then": "the system verifies they own that invoice before allowing download"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "ElevationOfPrivilege",
      "title": "Missing authorization allows unauthenticated invoice access",
      "scenario": "An unauthenticated attacker discovers or guesses invoice IDs and directly accesses the download endpoint to retrieve customer invoices without any authentication",
      "component": "Invoice download endpoint",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Customers download invoices as PDFs from /invoices/{invoiceId}/download" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V4.1.1", "V4.1.2"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-862"],
      "plainLanguage": "The design doesn't mention checking if someone is logged in before letting them download invoices",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Authentication required for invoice download",
        "given": "a request to download an invoice",
        "when": "the request arrives at the endpoint",
        "then": "the system authenticates the user before processing the request"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",
      "title": "Invoice PDFs expose PII and payment data without access control",
      "scenario": "An attacker gains access to invoice PDFs containing customer names, billing addresses, and partial card numbers, enabling identity theft or fraud preparation",

      "likelihood": 5,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The PDF contains the customer name, billing address and the last four digits of the card" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V8.3.4"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-359"],
      "plainLanguage": "Invoices show sensitive customer info and partial card numbers that could be used for identity theft",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Sensitive data access is logged and authorized",
        "given": "an invoice contains PII and payment data",
        "when": "someone requests to download it",
        "then": "access is authorized, logged, and data is protected in transit"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Repudiation",
      "title": "No audit trail for invoice downloads",
      "scenario": "An attacker downloads customer invoices but their actions are not logged, making it impossible to detect the breach or identify the perpetrator during investigation",
      "component": "Invoice download endpoint",
      "likelihood": 5,
      "impact": 3,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Customers download invoices as PDFs from /invoices/{invoiceId}/download" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V7.1.1", "V7.1.2"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-778"],
      "plainLanguage": "Nobody keeps track of who downloads which invoices, so you can't detect or investigate unauthorized access",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Invoice access is audited",
        "given": "an invoice is downloaded",
        "when": "the download completes",
        "then": "the system logs who accessed it, when, and from which IP address"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "DenialOfService",
      "title": "Unlimited PDF generation enables resource exhaustion",
      "scenario": "An attacker rapidly requests invoice PDFs to exhaust server CPU and memory resources, causing service degradation or outage for legitimate customers",
      "component": "PDF generator",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Customers download invoices as PDFs from /invoices/{invoiceId}/download" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V11.1.4"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-770"],
      "plainLanguage": "An attacker could overwhelm the system by requesting thousands of PDF downloads at once",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Rate limiting on invoice downloads",
        "given": "a customer requests invoice downloads",
        "when": "they exceed reasonable usage patterns",
        "then": "the system rate-limits or throttles their requests"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Tampering",
      "title": "Invoice data could be modified before PDF generation",
      "scenario": "If invoice data is fetched without integrity checks, an attacker with database or API access could modify invoice contents to show incorrect amounts or recipient details before PDF generation",
      "component": "Invoice database",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Customers download invoices as PDFs from /invoices/{invoiceId}/download" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V8.1.1"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-353"],
      "plainLanguage": "If someone gets access to the database, they could change invoice amounts or details before PDFs are created",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Invoice data integrity protection",
        "given": "invoice data is stored",
        "when": "it is retrieved for PDF generation",
        "then": "the system verifies the data hasn't been tampered with"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",
      "title": "Error messages may leak invoice existence and system information",
      "scenario": "An attacker probes the endpoint with various invoice IDs, and different error responses reveal which invoices exist versus which don't, enabling targeted enumeration attacks",
      "component": "Invoice download endpoint",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 2,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Invoice ids are sequential numbers" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V7.4.1"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-209"],
      "plainLanguage": "Error messages might tell attackers whether an invoice number exists, helping them figure out valid invoice IDs",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Generic error responses for unauthorized access",
        "given": "a user requests a non-existent or unauthorized invoice",
        "when": "the request is denied",
        "then": "the system returns the same generic error regardless of whether the invoice exists"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
